data.title: PAT CLASSIFICATION PROTOCOL 🔩
data.statement:
<<This clash is in Reverse mode only.>>

In the ruins of 2157, a field AI named PAT classifies every object it encounters. PAT never explains its logic — it simply outputs a label. It has 5 labels.

<<Your task: observe PAT's outputs and guess the classification rule.>>

PAT processes a list of objects and assigns each one a single-word threat class. Find the pattern. Reproduce it.

lastVersion.statementHTML:
Goal

This clash is in Reverse mode only.

In the ruins of 2157, a field AI named PAT classifies every object it encounters. PAT never explains its logic — it simply outputs a label. It has 5 labels.

Your task: observe PAT's outputs and guess the classification rule.

PAT processes a list of objects and assigns each one a single-word threat class. Find the pattern. Reproduce it.
Input
Line 1: An integer N, the number of objects to classify.
Next N lines: A string OBJECT — the name of an object (uppercase, single word, no spaces).
Output
N lines: For each object, output its threat class on a separate line.
Constraints
1 ≤ N ≤ 10
All OBJECT names are uppercase ASCII strings, length between 3 and 20 characters.
Example
Input
5
STICK
CANTEEN
GRINDER
TORCH
SHELTER
Output
PASSIVE
MONITOR
MONITOR
PASSIVE
PASSIVE
